caption:
Why do some people become rich, only to end up broke again? 💸

One reason could be that we’re taught how to earn money, but not how to manage it.

We avoid talking about money, ignore our spending habits, and sometimes pretend it doesn’t matter.

The first step? Track where your money comes from and where it goes. Then separate your expenses into needs and wants.

Because earning more won’t automatically build wealth. Knowing how to manage what you earn is what makes the difference.

Do you track your expenses, or do you figure it out at the end of the month? 👇

#FinanceWithSharan #PersonalFinance #MoneyManagement
